content:
Aisha M. (Finance): quick sync - LedgerIQ, ParseFlow, and ReconcileX are in the running for invoice reconciliation. CFO wants an approval memo + recommended vendor by Mon noon. Can we confirm outstanding items?
Ravi K. (Procurement): I'll consolidate price rows. Need clarity on pilot pricing, commit discounts, and termination fees. Who owns vendor conversations?
Tom (LedgerIQ Sales): happy to help. LedgerIQ offers a 90-day pilot at 25% list, no commit. Post-pilot typical term: 12 months with tiered discounts. Termination: 60 days notice after initial 12.
Lina S. (SRE): SRE ask: what infra footprint? We need on-prem gateway or is it cloud-only? Also encryption at rest by tenant?
Tom (LedgerIQ Sales): cloud-first, but we provide a small on-prem gateway appliance (container) for VPC peering customers. Tenant-level AES-256 at rest, HSM integration optional.
Diego P. (Legal): include data residency and subprocessor list. Also need sample DPA and indemnity limits for review.
Aisha M. (Finance): ParseFlow sent a counterintuitive clause: annual minimum spend clause tied to "processed document units". Can someone model that for our volume?
Ravi K. (Procurement): on it. Please confirm our avg monthly invoice count (prod): 24k documents/month, 95% within 30 pages. Will model 1yr and 3yr TCO.
Lina S. (SRE): technical blocker: ReconcileX requires a direct DB connector to our billing DB (read-only) - Ops prefers event-driven ingestion. Can their team adapt?
vendor-bot: "ReconcileX: connector team available, estimated 1 sprint (2w) to build event-based ingestion; sample connector docs: https://reconcilex.example/connectors"
Tom (LedgerIQ Sales): for comparison, LedgerIQ has native Kafka ingest and SFTP, plus prebuilt Snowflake ingestion.
Diego P. (Legal): FYI: ParseFlow's indemnity caps out at $500k; LedgerIQ proposes unlimited cap for data breach with standard carveouts. Need to escalate if true.
Aisha M. (Finance): Procurement - please flag negotiation levers (commit level, multi-year, reference case). SRE - add integration delta (engineer-weeks). Legal - flag risk items. I'll assemble decision memo Thursday evening for review.
Ravi K. (Procurement): will push vendors on pilot credits and ask LedgerIQ for a "pilot-to-contract" credit to offset migration. Also confirm whether ParseFlow charges for model retraining during onboarding.
Tom (LedgerIQ Sales): can do pilot credit up to $8k if we get signature on standard MSA within 30 days of pilot end.
Lina S. (SRE): rough delta: LedgerIQ integration = 3 engineer-days (Kafka + config), ParseFlow = 2 engineer-weeks (custom mapping UI + endpoint), ReconcileX = 2 engineer-weeks (event connector).
Aisha M. (Finance): add retention/archival costs - ParseFlow retention tier seems to charge $0.02/GB/month beyond 90 days. LedgerIQ includes 180-day retention in base.
Ravi K. (Procurement): noted. Diego - can you review ParseFlow indemnity and share redlines by tomorrow?
Diego P. (Legal): will do. Also ask vendors for SOC2 report and subprocessor list.
Tom (LedgerIQ Sales): attaching sample SOC2 url and subprocessor list in email. happy to send PDFs.
vendor-bot: "LedgerIQ SOC2 link sent to procurement@redwood.com"
Aisha M. (Finance): final ask: include a short table in the memo with 1) 12-month TCO (incl. integration & migration amortized), 2) pilot cost, 3) net present value of discounts, 4) top 3 legal risks. I'll draft template and paste here in a few hours.
Ravi K. (Procurement): placing a hold for exec review: please avoid committing to anything until after legal signs off. :lock:
Aisha M. (Finance): ack. Thanks all — will post template + initial numbers here by 5pm today.
